# Navyansh Kothari (NavyGeeks)

> Navyansh Kothari is an AI/ML Engineer at Ganit Inc (Chennai, India), an IEEE-published researcher, a mobile app developer, and the creator of the NavyGeeks tech YouTube channel. This site is his portfolio: projects, research papers, certifications, experience and education.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://www.navygeeks.in/): overview of skills, experience, projects, certifications and research
- [About & Contact](https://www.navygeeks.in/about/): who he is and how to reach him
- [Experience](https://www.navygeeks.in/experience/): work history (Ganit Inc, Hitwicket, NavyGeeks YouTube)
- [Education](https://www.navygeeks.in/education/): B.Tech CSE, VIT Vellore
- [Skills](https://www.navygeeks.in/skills/): Gen AI, machine learning, backend and mobile tech stack
- [Certifications](https://www.navygeeks.in/certifications/): AWS Solutions Architect - Associate, Claude Certified Architect, AWS AI Practitioner, OpenAI certifications and more
